documents.title: Part B  Transition (22 pages max, Sections 1-3 + cover)

sub.label: Upstream EU project
prompts: MANDATORY: which eligible upstream project does this Transition build on?
Options: EIC Pathfinder (incl. H2020 EIC pilot, FET-Open, FET-Proactive); ERC Proof of Concept; Horizon RIA; EDF research (civil applications only); Research Infrastructure project.

sub.label: 1.1 Innovation + breakthrough
prompts: Description of the technology + breakthrough vs upstream project results.

sub.label: 1.2 Maturation pathway (TRL 4 → 5/6)
prompts: Concrete technology maturation plan; validation in relevant environment.

sub.label: 1.3 IP + FTO + exploitation
prompts: IP strategy; FTO; ownership; access rights.

sub.label: 2.2 Commercialisation + scale-up plan (Transition Plan)
prompts: Customer engagement + regulatory pathway + investor strategy.
Optional but encouraged: upload the Transition Plan template separately.

sub.label: 3.2 Team + consortium capacity
prompts: Mono-beneficiary OR 2-5 entities from 2+ MS/AC  describe the team capability.

sub.label: 3.3 Resources (lump-sum)
prompts: Lump-sum budget tied to WP completion.

documents.title: Pitch deck for Jury Interview (11-13 weeks after deadline)

hand_offs.chat_cta: Does my ERC PoC project qualify me for Transition?
hand_offs.comply_cta: Check FTO + IP + ethics for maturation pathway
